name: regional-search-v1
evidence_class: independent analytic synthetic search checks; not field accuracy
acceptance: All three noiseless on-grid analytic combined searches recover the independent receiver and shared clock within numerical tolerance, including misleading source alternatives and unknown emitted tones.
Missing approved sources, unreviewed selected events and insufficient work budgets return explicit errors before searching; no default association or dropped term is substituted.
Completed reports account for every declared receiver/clock cell and event/source evaluation, preserve plan/input identities, and keep location_verified false.
No per-scene thresholds, weights, source lists or bounds may be tuned after predictions. Noisy/weak cases and excluded-clock controls are descriptive, including failures.

Compare Doppler-only, thunder-only and combined on identical data, candidate receivers, shared clock ranges and per-modality source/tone options. Disabled modalities' events are removed from the search plan only.
Evaluation labels are separate; predictions are written before evaluation reads them. This is local procedural separation, not an independently administered blind trial.
